## Context / Problem
A local `make verify` on the comment-only Group10 candidate `523a3163835c2a83175e95551595592f4b62abc0` failed `tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock.py::test_ref_backend_acquire_release_roundtrip`. Its isolated temporary repository's `git update-ref refs/reconciler/lock` exceeded `_ref_lock._LOCAL_TIMEOUT_SECS = 5.0` and raised `RefLockTimeoutError`. The suite had 2 failures, 19,710 passes and 93 skips in 8199.03 seconds while 4 full suites were concurrent. Group10 changed only 35 infrastructure comment paths; neither this test nor `_ref_lock.py` changed.

A controlled exact-node run on byte-identical bot-identity tree `2a12fbc2badebca8c3d33e6bb4c06c66af5b1532` passed with `pytest -q -n 2` while 2 full suites were concurrent (paired with the other failed node: 2/2 in 77.21 seconds). Nonreproduction does not establish the cause.

## Observation, hypotheses, experiment
**Observation:** A temp-repo `git update-ref` timed out at 5.0 seconds in the full run and succeeded in the narrower run.
**Hypotheses:** Host/process load delayed Git beyond the bound; test setup or a Git-side lock condition delayed this specific operation. Neither is proven.
**Experiment:** On a dedicated debug branch, record per-invocation elapsed time and relevant host load while repeating this exact test at controlled suite concurrency and consistent starting state. Inspect the temporary repo and Git trace if a slow call recurs. Compare to a working low-load run before changing code or timeout policy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify the mechanism with a repeatable controlled observation or another concrete trace; document counter-evidence.
- [ ] Fix the confirmed class of failure without weakening the lock's fail-closed behavior.
- [ ] Pass the exact test and the relevant full local/CI gate after the fix.

Full-run log: `/Users/joeoakhart/scratch/group10-final-verify-20261023-523a3163-38142/make-verify.log`. Exact-node log: `/Users/joeoakhart/scratch/group10-exact-failures-20261023-2a12-42286/pytest.log`.
